candidates.title: NIRVSS N-213 Laboratory
candidates.description: Near InfraRed Volatiles Spectrometer System (NIRVSS) engineering build in Ames N-213 Laboratory with Amanda Cook. The NIRVSS will fly on the Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover, or VIPER in its search for water on the south pole of the moon.

candidates.title: Moon Base Briefing at Max Power in KSC Studio
candidates.description: NASA Deputy Press Secretary George Alderman moderates an update on NASA’s Moon Base on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, at Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Located near the lunar South Pole, the Moon Base is humanity’s first outpost for long-term lunar exploration.
